race.description: Ladbrokes More On Tote Win Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: Plenty come out in the last. PERSIAN CAVIAR (8) is left on top. She's the daughter of Black Caviar who has shown decent ability in five runs to date, winning twice and placing in another couple. She resumes here off solid jumpout form and like that she's trained here. Can roll forward and take beating. ATTACHMENTS (5) ran a good race first up at Caulfield Heath and did bolt in second up last campaign. Tough draw and synthetic unknown but should take holding out. THE VOLTA (10) was behind ATTACHMENTS first up but didn't have the best of runs and she did some good things in deep races last campaign. Look for her charging home. SHYSTAR (11) resumes. She's trained here and draws for a soft run on speed having run quite well in a good race first up last time in, respecting.
